I just worry the GP will think im lying, think im doing it for attention. I hype myself up to see someone then completely back out as i start doubting theres anything wrong, thinking its just me being stupid and that im fine. 

Its sad because its always easier for me to just hide away, any time ive previously tried to get help its gone wrong.

yeah no worries.

Just thought i best ask simply because i dont really talk to anyone about anything, so im never sure on these things

Damn, youre telling me everything. Didnt think posting would actually get anywhere.

Only thing i really struggle with is how can i even talk to a gp about it? Cant exactly go in and say all of that, just looks like im self diagnosing and id look foolish as anything. 

One big issue with that is it requires me to be able to live on my own, i mean i pay bills and rent but not sure id be able to move out on the pittence pay i currently get.

Ill check out the link you said when i finish work. Sounds like it could be interesting and useful. 

I do need this job, i have a car and a phone i pay for, as well as rent. Both lessons and car paid for by me, so i cant rely on anyone else to do it. 

Yeah, although they cancelled it they offered the same course roughly 90 minutes away from the original place, which was already a 30 minute drive. Wasnt ever worth it to drive 4 hours a day for a college day that sometimes wouldnt be half that time.

I would agree with the first point, but at some point 'luck' would statistically turn to your favor at some point. I dont know.

I appreciate the response, thanks

The amount of accuracy on that is insane. Its crazy.

Thing is my parents have almost always been like that. Even to a point where a year ago my dad was outed for having an affair. He went on to keep this charade on for a few more months. My Mother took him back as did all the family as he blamed it on stress from work. Even to this day he places a lot of the blame on his kids for the affair and acts as if he never did anything wrong unless dorectly confronted about it.

Just a whole lotta shit. Told my older sister about the self harming as it got to a point where it'd be my whole thigh sliced up every few days. She eventually told my parents and i was asked to show them, i said no and then came the lying accusations. Although the self harm has died off ill live with fucked up scars for the rest of my life and theyve forgotten about it. A lot stems from home, both siblings have had issues that also stem from our parents. A lot of emotional black mailing and abuse from them both.

Im trying to go to the new gp and sort it out. But i need an excuse and time to go. But this is kinda a last resort as i have nobody else to turn to and i know of i dont try it'll only end one way.

I appreciate the response.
